description: Recently settled sales for a market. `amount` is the EXACT settled total (incl. fee) from the on-chain fill where the indexer recorded it, with `settledAt` the block time and `exact: true`; otherwise it falls back to the listed ask with `exact: false` (a decayed Dutch auction settles BELOW its listed amount, so treat inexact rows as an upper bound).
name: get_recent_trades
